scientific_integrity: A complete algebraic proof is provided; small-field computations are verification only, not infinite proof. No claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only \(k\)-algebra automorphisms of \(T_k(V)/(V)^3\) for \(n\ge3\); conjugacy is by the quadratic-shear kernel above a fixed linear involution, not by the full automorphism group. Group cohomology is standard, but explicit rank-resolved enumeration and cubic obstruction are claimed; unindexed stronger literature remains possible.
title: Involution fibers and cubic conjugacy obstructions in truncated free associative algebras
